description: External COBOL repositories used as independent test inputs for COBOL Phoenix. They are fetched by scripts/fetch-corpus.sh at the pinned commits and are never copied into this repository.

repositories.license: No license file in the repository (all rights reserved by default). Used only as an analysis/test input fetched at test time; no code is redistributed.
repositories.build_command: make all   (cobc -I cpy -O2 -x -o build/bin/driver-nbuw001 cobol/drivers/DRIVER-NBUW001.cob cobol/NB-UW-001.cob, ...)
repositories.test_command: make test   (sh tests/run-tests.sh: diffs driver stdout against tests/expected/*.out)
repositories.migration_unit: NBUW001 - new business eligibility, rating and premium calculation (LINKAGE: WS-POLICY-MASTER-REC, LK-UW-RESULT-CODE, LK-UW-ERROR-MSG)

repositories.role: independent validation corpus (interactive banking, sequential files)
repositories.license: No license file in the repository (all rights reserved by default). Used only as an analysis/test input fetched at test time; no code is redistributed.
repositories.build_command: make build   (cobc -x -o bankmain BANKMAIN.cbl; cobc -x -o seeddata SEEDDATA.cbl)
repositories.test_command: make test   (bash test.sh: 53 grep-based assertions over interactive sessions)

repositories.role: advanced corpus used to find parser limitations (free format, file I/O, ALTER, REPORT SECTION, SORT)
repositories.license: MIT (Copyright (c) 2026 Albert Mendes). Only fetched for testing; no code is redistributed. The repository's Python bridge and AI features are not used.
